# This year's findings compared with last year

*Researcher · this year: findings/common-themes.md · last year: research/last-year/interview-findings.md*

## What stayed the same

- **Dates.** Last year two of three clients named keeping to dates; this year all three did.
- **Plain writing.** Mentioned by one client each year as a reason to stay.

## What changed

| Last year | This year |
|-----------|-----------|
| The most common complaint was slow replies to email (two clients). | Nobody mentioned replies. |
| Nobody asked to see work earlier. | Two clients want to see work, or hear about dates, sooner. |
| Price came up twice. | Price did not come up. |

## What it might mean

Replying faster, which the studio worked on last year, seems to have landed. The new ask is about being surprised
late in a project, which matches what Writer's quarterly summary proposes: a halfway check-in.

**Caution:** last year's three clients are not the same three as this year's, so a change may be a different
client, not a different experience. Two of the six took part both years.
